messages.content:
**Latest news on Fervo Energy (Nasdaq: FRVO)**

The biggest recent development is that Fervo Energy's first power plant at Cape Station in Beaver County, Utah, has reached commercial operation — making it the first greenfield enhanced geothermal (EGS) development in the world to hit contractual commercial operations.

**Commercial operation reached ahead of schedule**
- The first GeoBlock achieved **33 MW of net power production**, meeting the expected production threshold under its Power Purchase Agreement (PPA), and is now generating revenue. **First Power milestone (late September)**
- Cape Station achieved **First Power** on September 24, 2026 — the first time a utility-scale greenfield EGS development reached this milestone — just over four months after Fervo's May 2026 IPO. - Source: [Fervo Energy — Achieves First Power at Cape Station](https://fervoenergy.com/fervo-energy-achieves-first-power-at-cape-station-a-landmark-moment-for-the-future-of-enhanced-geothermal-systems/)
